content.title: 2026 Masters Saturday TV coverage: How to watch Round 3 at Augusta National
content.text: Rory McIlroy has a huge lead heading into Saturday's third round at Augusta National. David Cannon/Getty Images You’re reading our viewer’s guide for Round 3. To see complete TV coverage and streaming schedules for Sunday’s final round of the 2026 Masters, click here.———The third round of the 2026 Masters gets underway Saturday morning, April 11, at Augusta National. Here’s everything you need to know to watch the tournament on Saturday, including full Masters TV coverage, streaming info and Round 3 tee times.How to watch Masters on SaturdaySeveral star players put together solid starts to get toward the top of the leaderboard at the halfway point of the Masters. But the man at the very top of that leaderboard is way, way ahead. Defending champion Rory McIlroy showed off his elite skills and knowledge of Augusta National in Round 2, making birdies on six of his last seven holes to shoot a seven-under 65. 9 surprising players who missed the 2026 Masters cut By: Josh Schrock The incredible round moved McIlroy to 12 under, giving him a six-shot lead heading into Saturday’s third round. That’s the biggest 36-hole lead in Masters history.Major winners Patrick Reed, Justin Rose, Shane Lowry, Tommy Fleetwood and Jason Day are among McIlroy’s closest chasers with two rounds to play. But they all have a lot of ground to cover to prevent McIlroy from winning a second-straight green jacket.Bryson DeChambeau, on the other hand, will not be playing the weekend. He made a triple bogey at 18 on Friday to miss the cut.You can watch the third round of the Masters on TV via CBS, which will air coverage beginning at 2 p.m. ET on Saturday. Masters.com, the Masters app, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and the ESPN App will provide streaming coverage beginning Saturday at 9:53 a.m. ET.Below you will find everything you need to know to watch the third round of the 2026 Masters.How to watch on TV SaturdayCBS will provide third-round TV coverage of the 2026 Masters on Saturday from 2-7 p.m. ET.How to stream online SaturdayYou can stream the third round of the 2026 Masters via Masters.com, the Masters app, the ESPN App, Amazon Prime Video, Paramount+ and DirecTV, with several streaming options available.
